claim_boundary: method governance ledger for finite software artifacts; not empirical, clinical, neural, practice-efficacy, awakening, or physical qFEP evidence

assumptions: finite channel screen is an inspectable surrogate for the source paper's boundary role
hard_constraints: admissible relabelings must preserve the observed bitstream
modeling_choices: sector labels treated as semantic relabelings

assumptions: grid parameters are software surrogates, not measured traits
hard_constraints: Delta F sign convention must be fixed
modeling_choices: prior precision and metacognitive access grid

assumptions: profile differences are software hypotheses about QRF deployments
the runtime dependency check does not certify active-inference optimality, human behavior, or scientific validity
hard_constraints: state and policy posteriors must normalize at every step
runtime dependency check is limited to pinned package, import, agent construction, state inference, and policy-posterior normalization
modeling_choices: profile-specific priors, preferences, and transition relaxation drive action differences

assumptions: stochastic variability tests software robustness, not human variability
hard_constraints: random draws must sample normalized distributions
replay with same seed must reproduce rows

assumptions: two-qubit open-system dynamics are a finite method witness, not physical qFEP
hard_constraints: ensemble density preserves trace and PSD

assumptions: finite obstruction cases do not prove the source paper's full QRF contextuality
hard_constraints: global-section LP feasibility must match controls

assumptions: practice vocabulary can guide future UI without implying outcomes
falsification_controls: claim language blocks therapeutic, awakening, clinical, and neural claims
hard_constraints: protocols must map to model interventions only
modeling_choices: practice language represented as bounded interface specs

assumptions: metadata plus render checks reduce false certification but do not prove reader comprehension
modeling_choices: machine-readable source maps and visual contracts
